plannedActions.description: Replace afconvert subprocess in AudioStore.convertCAFToM4A() with AVAudioConverter implementation

references.text: CRITICAL: AVAudioConverter maintains state - recreating per-buffer causes AAC encoder to prepend 2112 frames of silence

AVAudioConverter produces 37,352 bytes with 31,817 byte free box (85% of file). afconvert produces 8,680 bytes with 3,130 byte free box (36% of file). Identical mdat (4,588 bytes), identical decoded audio.
ffprobe analysis: both files decode to identical 42KB PCM, both use AAC (LC) codec with skip_samples=2112 priming, identical packet structure
